features.title: Versioned extension contracts, fail-closed application runner, exact PTY publication, and isolated bounded runtime

accessibility.rationale: Three explicit approval decisions have text, pointer, focus-aware keyboard, and accessibility semantics. Controlled native screen-reader evidence remains external.

security.rationale: Production ownership is compiled but hard disabled; the linked package remains unverified and authorization denies before executable resolution.

resource_lifetime.rationale: The app runner bounds active work at 50 and audits, receipts, reconnect candidates, and durable receipt history at 256; it reconciles actual child exit, cancellation, route close, failed publication, and shutdown. Native forced descendant cleanup and sustained leak proof remain external.

storage_hygiene.rationale: Managed completion receipts use a private, atomic, primary/previous-recovery store bounded to 256 records and 2 MiB; destination, terminal text, credentials, paths, and executable identity are excluded.

resilience.rationale: Capacity, stale scope/source, replay, executable replacement, pre-publication completion, nonzero or unavailable child status, persistence recovery/saturation, revocation, route close, and app shutdown fail closed with fixed redacted outcomes.

visual_quality.rationale: Renderer-neutral and hit-geometry tests cover three compact review cards and three non-overlapping decisions from tiny through 8K-equivalent viewports; native pixel inspection remains external.

features.title: Explicit SSH inventory composition with generation safety and last-known-good health

accessibility.rationale: Truthful state and setup labels are model-level evidence; the product adapter is recorded separately and controlled screen-reader evidence remains external.

security.rationale: The application passes only explicit exact grants to capability-free static inventory and adds no process, network, authentication, credential, listener, or PTY authority.

performance.rationale: One worker serializes bounded scans and obsolete generations cannot publish; controlled end-to-end refresh latency remains later evidence.

resource_lifetime.rationale: Router owns one service; explicit shutdown cancels current/pending work, clears memory-only grants, wakes the worker, and joins its handle. The last handle repeats the safe teardown.

storage_hygiene.rationale: Composition reads the validated transactional D4 metadata document and does not add another metadata authority.

resilience.rationale: Failed refreshes retain the immutable last-known-good catalog behind a redacted stale state and stale completions cannot replace a newer request.

visual_quality.rationale: This service slice contains no renderer; the adjacent M1 product assurance entry owns structured rendering evidence.

performance.rationale: The local Windows 10,000-record release projection is below 16 ms; named-hardware longitudinal enforcement remains controlled evidence.

visual_quality.rationale: This persistence slice has no renderer; native product pixels remain a separate F3 gate.

windows.rationale: Windows-local tests exercise transactional persistence and injected failure paths; hosted native evidence remains the release authority.

linux.rationale: Unix-only no-follow link tests are owned here; a native run was not part of the M0 Windows reconciliation.

features.title: Nonactivated direct OpenSSH review, managed lifecycle, receipts, and guarded PTY route

accessibility.rationale: The review uses text plus icon/color and exposes exactly three focusable decisions: Allow once, Allow for session, and Deny. A/Enter is focus-aware, S and D are explicit, the literal dialog remains trapped and inert, and controlled native screen-reader evidence remains external.

security.rationale: Literal input and stale inventory fail closed. The typed request reaches one bounded application runner, but the const-false activation and unverified linked package deny before executable resolution. Current resolved executable review binding, attestation, protected approvals, and native proof remain gates.

performance.rationale: On the recorded Windows host, synchronous selected-record preparation measured 6.3520-6.6011 microseconds. Literal validation is linear over at most 512 bytes during the dedicated editor and composition occurs only on explicit Review; both remain off startup, renderer, PTY, and resize hot paths. Stable-hardware and activated process/PTY latency remain controlled evidence.

resource_lifetime.rationale: One shared runner owns at most 50 active leases and 256 audits; ContextManager owns any future PTY/route and rollback. Production keeps zero managed children while activation is false. Native forced descendant cleanup and sustained resource proof remain external.

storage_hygiene.rationale: Only provider-neutral completion receipts are queued off the runner hot path and stored atomically with private permissions, no-follow identity checks, primary/previous recovery, 256-record and 2-MiB ceilings; destinations, terminal text, credentials, executable paths, and digests are excluded.

resilience.rationale: Preparation invalidates on owned revisions; hostile input and stale scope fail closed. Runner capacity, pre-publication completion, failed publication, route close, revocation, and shutdown have fixed redacted recovery and exact cleanup ownership.

visual_quality.rationale: The live renderer uses compact icon-labelled Connection, Safety, and Launch cards plus three non-overlapping approval decisions. Invalid input remains denied, background hits remain inert, and bounded geometry passes from 90x70 through 7680x4320 at 200 percent scale; controlled native pixel review remains external.

linux.rationale: The pure contract is platform-neutral; this change did not execute on Linux and hosted native evidence remains required.

macos.rationale: The pure contract is platform-neutral; this change did not execute on macOS and hosted native evidence remains required.
